name: Generative Vertex-based Radiance Fields
definition: A generative human vertex-based radiance field parameterized by vertices of the parametric human template SMPL. It maps each 3D point to the local coordinate system defined on its neighboring vertices and uses the corresponding vertex feature and local coordinates for mapping it to color and density values.
summary: Generative Vertex-based Radiance Fields maps 3D points to color and density using K nearest SMPL vertices and local coordinate systems, enabling free control over camera pose, human pose, shape, and part-level editing.
